messages.subject: Joint Posterior Distribution of parameters and random effects
parts:
Hi,

I am wondering whether it is sufficient to sample GLMM's model hyper/parameters and  their random effects from TMB::sdreport joint precision matrix assuming they all from multivariate normal distribution. If it is sufficient, how will these TMB model parameters sample performance (for each parameter/random effect or the parameter/random effect vector) differ from INLA() posterior model sample?



Thanks,
